name: youtube-pulse
description: Your channel's latest videos and view counts, with gains since you last looked

channel_id.title: YouTube channel ID
channel_id.description: Required. Your channel ID, the one that starts with UC (YouTube Studio → Settings → Channel → Advanced settings). Not your @handle.

count.title: Videos to show
count.description: How many of your latest videos the card lists (1 to 15; the RSS feed holds 15).
